description: Small-Boat Sailing teaches you to sail a small boat safely: hazards and first aid, Safety Afloat and the rules of the road, weather, preparing and rigging a boat, points of sail, tacking and jibing, capsize and person-overboard recovery, knots, and boat care.

safety.note: Sailing follows Safety Afloat with a qualified supervisor; pass the swimmer test and wear a life jacket.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (safety and Safety Afloat, rules of the road, weather and float plans, sailing skills and rescues, knots and lines, boat care and terminology) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
